/*
  ESP32-S3 USB MIDI Electronic Drum
  ---------------------------------
  USB MIDI:
    ESP32-S3 Native USB OTG

  Required:
    - ESP32 Arduino Core 3.x
    - HelloDrum library

  Arduino IDE:
    Tools -> USB Mode -> USB-OTG (TinyUSB)
*/

#include <Arduino.h>
#include "USB.h"
#include "USBMIDI.h"
#include <hellodrum.h>

// SETTINGS

byte HIGHTOM[6] = {
  100,  // sensitivity (1-100)
  10,   // threshold (1-100)
  10,   // scan time
  30,   // mask time
  50,   // MIDI note
  1     // curve type (0-4)
};

byte HIMIDTOM[6] = {
  100,  // sensitivity (1-100)
  10,   // threshold (1-100)
  10,   // scan time
  30,   // mask time
  48,   // MIDI note
  1     // curve type (0-4)
};

byte FLOORTOM[6] = {
  100,  // sensitivity (1-100)
  10,   // threshold (1-100)
  10,   // scan time
  30,   // mask time
  41,   // MIDI note
  1     // curve type (0-4)
};

byte SNARE[10] = {
  100, //sensitivity (1-100)
  10,  //threshold (1-100)
  30,  //scan time (1-100)
  10,  //mask time (1-100)
  10,  //rim sensitivity (1-100)
  3,   //rim threshold (1-100)
  1,   //curve type (0-4)
  38,  //note (0-127)
  40,  //note of rim shot (0-127)
  37   //note of cross stick (0-127)
};

byte HIHAT[7] = {
  100, //sensitivity
  10,  //threshold
  10,  //scan start
  30,  //scan end
  0,   //curve type
  46,  //note of open
  42,  //note of close
};

byte HIHAT_PEDAL[7] = {
  75, //sensitivity (Hold the pedal at the position where you want to send 127(full open) in the MIDI CC, and read the Analog Read value in the TCRT5000. Divide the value by 10 and enter the value.)
  35, //threshold (Hold the pedal at the position where you want to send 0(close) in the MIDI CC, and read the Analog Read value in the TCRT5000. Divide the value by 10 and enter the value.)
  45, //scan start (When the analogRead value reaches this value * 10, the scan will start and the time will be recorded.)
  52, //scan end (When the analogRead value reaches this value * 10, the scan is finished and the time taken for the scan is referenced to determine the velocity.Then noteOn will be sent.The default value is 90, the same as Sensitivity. This means that the pedal is closed at the point where MIDI CC is 127.)
  10, //pedal sensitivity (This value multiplied by 100 is the time used to determine the velocity of the pedal. If the time taken from the scan start position to the scan end position is more than 1000 milliseconds, the velocity will be set to 1. So, if you feel that the velocity is low, either increase pedalSensitivity or increase the value of scan start.)
  0,  //curve type
  44  //note of pedal
};

byte CRASH[10] = {
  100, //sensitivity
  10,  //threshold
  10,  //scan time
  30,  //mask time
  4,   //edge threshold
  5,   //cup threshold
  1,   //curve type(0-4)
  49,  //note of bow
  55,  //note of edge
  53   //note of cup
};

byte RIDE[10] = {
  100, //sensitivity
  10,  //threshold
  10,  //scan time
  30,  //mask time
  4,   //edge threshold
  5,   //cup threshold
  1,   //curve type(0-4)
  51,  //note of bow
  59,  //note of edge
  53   //note of cup
};

byte KICK[6] = {
  100,  // sensitivity (1-100)
  10,   // threshold (1-100)
  10,   // scan time
  30,   // mask time
  35,   // MIDI note
  1     // curve type (0-4)
};

// Change the USB MIDI device name
SET_USB_MIDI_DEVICE_NAME("ESP32-S3 Drum");

USBMIDI MIDI;

HelloDrum highTom(4);
HelloDrum highMidTom(5);
HelloDrum floorTom(6);
HelloDrum snare(7, 8);
HelloDrum hihat(1);
HelloDrum hihatPedal(2);
HelloDrum crash(3, 13);
HelloDrum ride(9, 14);
HelloDrum kick(10);

void setup()
{
  // Start USB MIDI
  MIDI.begin();
  USB.begin();

  // Set curve type
  highTom.setCurve(HIGHTOM[5]);
  highMidTom.setCurve(HIMIDTOM[5]);
  floorTom.setCurve(FLOORTOM[5]);
  snare.setCurve(SNARE[6]);
  hihat.setCurve(HIHAT[4]);
  hihatPedal.setCurve(HIHAT_PEDAL[5]);
  crash.setCurve(CRASH[6]);
  ride.setCurve(RIDE[6]);
  kick.setCurve(KICK[5]);
}

void loop()
{
  // Read piezo

  highTom.singlePiezo(
    HIGHTOM[0],
    HIGHTOM[1],
    HIGHTOM[2],
    HIGHTOM[3]
  );

  highMidTom.singlePiezo(
    HIMIDTOM[0],
    HIMIDTOM[1],
    HIMIDTOM[2],
    HIMIDTOM[3]
  );

  floorTom.singlePiezo(
    FLOORTOM[0],
    FLOORTOM[1],
    FLOORTOM[2],
    FLOORTOM[3]
  );

  snare.dualPiezo(
    SNARE[0],
    SNARE[1],
    SNARE[2],
    SNARE[3],
    SNARE[4],
    SNARE[5]
  );

  hihat.HH(
    HIHAT[0],
    HIHAT[1],
    HIHAT[2],
    HIHAT[3]
  );

  hihatPedal.hihatControl(
    HIHAT_PEDAL[0],
    HIHAT_PEDAL[1],
    HIHAT_PEDAL[2],
    HIHAT_PEDAL[3],
    HIHAT_PEDAL[4]
  );

  crash.cymbal3zone(
    CRASH[0],
    CRASH[1],
    CRASH[2],
    CRASH[3],
    CRASH[4],
    CRASH[5]
  );

  ride.cymbal3zone(
    RIDE[0],
    RIDE[1],
    RIDE[2],
    RIDE[3],
    RIDE[4],
    RIDE[5]
  );

  kick.singlePiezo(
    KICK[0],
    KICK[1],
    KICK[2],
    KICK[3]
  );

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // HIGH TOM HIT

  if (highTom.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      HIGHTOM[4],         // MIDI note
      highTom.velocity,   // velocity 1-127
      10              // MIDI channel
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      HIGHTOM[4],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // HI-MID TOM HIT

  if (highMidTom.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      HIMIDTOM[4],         // MIDI note
      highMidTom.velocity,   // velocity 1-127
      10              // MIDI channel
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      HIMIDTOM[4],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // FLOOR TOM HIT

  if (floorTom.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      FLOORTOM[4],         // MIDI note
      floorTom.velocity,   // velocity 1-127
      10              // MIDI channel
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      FLOORTOM[4],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // SNARE HIT

  // HEAD
  if (snare.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      SNARE[7],       // MIDI note
      snare.velocity, // velocity 1-127
      10              // MIDI channel
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      SNARE[7],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //RIM
  else if (snare.hitRim == true)
  {
    if (snare.velocity > 60)
    {
      MIDI.noteOn(
        SNARE[8],
        snare.velocity,
        10
      );

      MIDI.noteOff(
        SNARE[8],
        0,
        10
      );
    }
    else
    {
      MIDI.noteOn(
        SNARE[9],
        snare.velocity * 2,
        10
      );

      MIDI.noteOff(
        SNARE[9],
        0,
        10
      );
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // HIHAT HIT

  if (hihat.hit == true)
  {
    //check open or close
    //1.open
    if (hihatPedal.openHH == true)
    {
      MIDI.noteOn(
        HIHAT[5],
        hihat.velocity,
        10
      ); //(note, velocity, channel)

      MIDI.noteOff(
        HIHAT[5],
        0,
        10
      );
    }

    //2.close
    else if (hihatPedal.closeHH == true)
    {
      MIDI.noteOn(
        HIHAT[6],
        hihat.velocity,
        10
      );

      MIDI.noteOff(
        HIHAT[6],
        0,
        10
      );
    }
  }

  //when pedal is closed
  if (hihatPedal.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      HIHAT_PEDAL[6],
      hihatPedal.velocity,
      10
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      HIHAT_PEDAL[6],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //sending state of pedal with controll change
  if (hihatPedal.moving == true)
  {
    MIDI.controlChange(
      4,
      hihatPedal.pedalCC,
      10
    );
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // CRASH HIT

  //BOW
  if (crash.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      CRASH[7],
      crash.velocity,
      10
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      CRASH[7],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //EDGE
  else if (crash.hitRim == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      CRASH[8],
      crash.velocity,
      10
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      CRASH[8],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //CUP
  else if (crash.hitCup == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      CRASH[9],
      crash.velocity,
      10
    );
    MIDI.noteOff(
      CRASH[9],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //CHOKE
  if (crash.choke == true)
  {
    MIDI.polyPressure(CRASH[7], 127, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(CRASH[8], 127, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(CRASH[9], 127, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(CRASH[7], 0, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(CRASH[8], 0, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(CRASH[9], 0, 10);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // RIDE HIT

  //BOW
  if (ride.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      RIDE[7],
      ride.velocity,
      10
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      RIDE[7],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //EDGE
  else if (ride.hitRim == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      RIDE[8],
      ride.velocity,
      10
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      RIDE[8],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //CUP
  else if (ride.hitCup == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      RIDE[9],
      ride.velocity,
      10
    );
    MIDI.noteOff(
      RIDE[9],
      0,
      10
    );
  }

  //CHOKE
  if (ride.choke == true)
  {
    MIDI.polyPressure(RIDE[7], 127, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(RIDE[8], 127, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(RIDE[9], 127, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(RIDE[7], 0, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(RIDE[8], 0, 10);
    MIDI.polyPressure(RIDE[9], 0, 10);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // KICK HIT

  if (kick.hit == true)
  {
    MIDI.noteOn(
      KICK[4],         // MIDI note
      kick.velocity,   // velocity 1-127
      10              // MIDI channel
    );

    MIDI.noteOff(
      KICK[4],
      0,
      10
    );
  }
}
